name: The Maybourne Riviera
insider_take: Perched on a clifftop between Monaco and Italy, The Maybourne Riviera is where old-world French Riviera glamour meets contemporary luxury in one of the Mediterranean's most exclusive enclaves.
whats_special: This architectural marvel sits on the same dramatic coastline that inspired Le Corbusier's modernist designs. The hotel's terraced gardens cascade down toward the azure Mediterranean, offering unobstructed views of the Côte d'Azur. Roquebrune-Cap-Martin itself is home to the medieval Château de Roquebrune, one of France's oldest feudal castles, dating back to the 10th century.
pro_tip: Walk the Sentier du Littoral coastal path at sunset – this scenic trail connects to Monaco and offers breathtaking views of the hotel's clifftop setting from below.
dont_miss: The nearby Cabanon Le Corbusier, the famous architect's tiny vacation cabin where he spent his final years, and the charming medieval village streets of old Roquebrune with their 1,000-year-old olive tree – one of the oldest in France.
pros: Spectacular Mediterranean Sea views from clifftop location
Ultra-luxurious suites and penthouses with private terraces
World-class dining with Michelin-starred chef cuisine
Exclusive access to private beach club and yacht facilities
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive boutique size
